title: Build checkpoints
description: An app's build checkpoints, in .a2app/checkpoint.json: the moments a creation stops for the person — the builder's clarifying questions, and the review of Part A of reference/requirements.md before anything is built. Runtime state, written only by `agent-app <dir> checkpoint` and `scaffold --checkpoints`: never committed, exported or fingerprinted. A harness's build panel reads it through `checkpoint show`, and finds an open one on the app's row in `agent-app list --json` (`checkpoint`, the fields of $defs/summary).

mode.description: Where this build's checkpoints are shown, recorded at scaffold: `ui` when a harness's build panel renders them and records the reply; absent or `chat` when the builder relays them in chat. The AGENT_APP_CHECKPOINTS environment variable overrides it per process.

current.description: The checkpoint opened last, whatever its status; null before the first.

round.description: Which batch of questions (at most 2: one batch and one follow-up), or which review of Part A.

status.description: pending: waiting for the person. answered: questions answered. approved: Part A approved, and the dated line written in ### Approval. changes: the person asked for Part A to be revised. cancelled: withdrawn by the builder.

why.description: Why the answer matters, shown under the question.

options.description: Choices the person can pick; none for a free-text question. The person may always answer in their own words.

choices.description: Among the question's options; at most one unless multiSelect.

answers.description: From a panel's form: one per question, in order; an empty answer leaves the decision to the builder.

text.description: The person's reply in their own words: a chat reply to questions, or a change request on a review.

edited.description: The person edited Part A themselves.

by.description: Where the approval was given: a harness's name, or chat.
